title: Exercise or Extra Fries? Behavioral Drivers of Obesity Over the Life Cycle,
title_primary: Exercise or Extra Fries? Behavioral Drivers of Obesity Over the Life Cycle,
authors: Neha Bairoliya, Ray Miller, Vegard M Nygaard
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As America faces an obesity epidemic and its economic consequences, the factors driving weight variation across the U.S. population remain unclear, especially since these differences extend well beyond commonly studied channels like income or education. We leverage a unique thirty-year panel of U.S. registered nurses to examine the changes in body mass index (BMI) with age, the impact of lifestyle choices on body weight in adulthood, and the role of inherited metabolic traits and childhood preference formation. Our empirical findings reveal that among individuals who enter adulthood with a healthy body mass, those in the top diet quality or exercise deciles at age thirty are roughly 50% more likely to maintain a healthy BMI and avoid morbidities three decades later, compared to those in the bottom deciles. To better understand the drivers of weight gain, we propose a novel structural framework of endogenous BMI evolution where initial heterogeneity is amplified by behaviors to explain much of the observed divergence in weight. Counterfactual experiments using the model indicate that initial conditions, such as fixed metabolic types, account for at least one-third of the variance in weight at older ages. While course correction through behaviors can only partially compensate for poor initial conditions at the onset of adulthood, we find that promoting healthy behaviors in adults can reduce total health care expenses by at least 8% annually.

abstract: Payroll data from Great Britain reveal that men are paid more than women upon entry into firms. Although this hiring wage gap has narrowed over the past two decades, it still accounts for over two‐thirds of the steady‐state gender pay gap—the wage gap that would eventually prevail under constant employment levels. A significant part of this hiring wage gap is not explained by men and women working in different firms and occupations. Even when hiring men and women into the same job, there remains an unexplained hiring wage gap that favors men by 2.4 log points.
abstract_zh: 英国薪资数据显示，男性在进入企业时获得的薪酬高于女性。尽管这一入职薪资差距在过去二十年中有所缩小，但它仍占稳态性别薪资差距——即在就业水平恒定时最终会存在的薪资差距——的三分之二以上。这一入职薪资差距的显著部分无法由男性和女性在不同企业和职业中工作来解释。即使在招聘男性和女性进入同一岗位时，仍存在一个无法解释的入职薪资差距，偏向男性2.4个对数点。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies formal employment dynamics using linked employer–employee data from eight countries spanning a wide income range from Kenya to Chile. First, we show that formality rates increase with development, both between and within countries, because more workers enter the formal sector, not because they spend more time in formal jobs. Second, formal labor market fluidity increases with development, as workers hold more formal jobs, spend less time in each job, and less time between jobs. Third, greater fluidity is associated with higher life-cycle wage growth, which is largely accounted for by within- rather than between-firm wage gains.
abstract_zh: 本文利用涵盖从肯尼亚到智利等八个收入水平差异显著国家的关联雇主-雇员数据，研究正规就业动态。首先，我们表明，正规就业率随发展水平提高而上升，无论是在国家间还是国家内部，这主要是因为更多工人进入正规部门，而非他们在正规工作岗位上停留时间更长。其次，正规劳动力市场的流动性随发展水平增强，表现为工人持有更多正规工作、每份工作持续时间更短、工作间隔时间更短。第三，更高的流动性与更高的生命周期工资增长相关，而这种增长主要源于企业内部的工资提升，而非企业间的变动。

title: Closed Form Estimators for a Class of Semiparametric Multinomial Choice Models

title_primary: 一类半参数多项选择模型的闭式估计量

authors: Daniel Ackerberg, Haiqing Xu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We consider a semiparametric multinomial choice model that allows for an arbitrary joint distribution of choice specific unobservables that are independent of explanatory variables. This model permits relatively flexible substitution patterns between choices. To minimize computational difficulties, we restrict attention on estimators of the model that can be expressed in closed form. We combine and extend various results from the existing literature to enforce economic restrictions implied by the model and to attain “as efficient estimators as we can” - given the closed form requirement. Some aspects of our estimators achieve the semiparametric efficiency bound, while others do not. In Monte-Carlo experiments, we study how various strategies increase efficiency, and compare the efficiency of our best estimators to computationally more challenging, non-closed form, estimators that are efficient.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个半参数多项选择模型，该模型允许选择特定不可观测因素具有任意联合分布，且这些因素与解释变量相互独立。此模型能够容纳选择之间相对灵活的替代模式。为减少计算难度，我们仅关注能以闭式形式表达的模型估计量。我们结合并扩展现有文献中的多种结果，以施加模型隐含的经济约束，并在闭式要求下尽可能实现“高效估计”。我们提出的估计量在某些方面达到了半参数效率界，而在其他方面则未达到。通过蒙特卡洛实验，我们研究了不同策略如何提升效率，并将我们最优估计量的效率与计算上更具挑战性、非闭式但高效的估计量进行了比较。

title: 制造业如何跨越“内卷式”竞争？——链主企业主导的多重博弈与治理重构

abstract: 当前，“内卷式”竞争正成为抑制企业创新活力、阻滞产业高质量跃迁的关键问题。本文聚焦中国制造业产业链层面“内卷式”竞争的形成机制与治理路径，通过构建链主企业、供应商与消费者的三方动态博弈模型，揭示纵向博弈与横向竞争双重作用下“内卷式”竞争产生的微观机理。研究发现，链主企业虽然对于产业链稳定和技术创新有一定积极作用，但若放任其在产业链中的主导性持续强化，可能引发三种负面效应：（1）产业链低端锁定效应，形成长期“低质量、低价格、低利润”的均衡陷阱；（2）利益分配失衡，产业链利润分配呈现“马太效应”，中小微企业利润空间收窄；（3）政策传导低效，产业补贴存在“截留效应”，大部分补贴转移至链主企业。基于价值链治理与制度变迁理论，本文提出“行业协会协同治理+渐进式质量标准演进”的双轨治理路径：一方面，通过多中心治理结构降低单边依赖度；另一方面，通过设定动态质量标准引导产品质量升级。本研究将产业链治理从“有效市场+有为政府”的二元范式拓展至包含行业自组织与质量标准引领的多元框架，为综合整治“内卷式”竞争提供了理论支撑与可操作路径。

title: The Value of Names: Civil Society, Information, and Governing Multinationals,
title_zh: 名称的价值：公民社会、信息与跨国公司的治理
title_primary: 名称的价值：公民社会、信息与跨国公司的治理
title_secondary: The Value of Names: Civil Society, Information, and Governing Multinationals,
authors: David H Kreitmeir, Nathan Lane, Paul A Raschky
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Can markets discipline socially costly misbehavior abroad? We explore the market penalty associated with major human rights violations—specifically, the assassination of mining activists, a context where formal legal recourse is rare and events often do not involve counterparties. We show that firms featured in media coverage of these incidents experience significant, negative abnormal stock returns. Whereas reactions to related forms of corporate misconduct may be transitory or muted, we find that the market responses are both substantial and persistent, with a median 10-day loss exceeding USD 100 million. Since formal legal sanction is exceedingly rare, we consider the role of market penalties. We highlight three mechanisms that are consistent with reputational costs: (1) Media attention magnifies the market response. (2) Information-sensitive institutional investors systematically divest following assassination events. (3) Events reduce future trade, leading to a 19% decline in new contracts with counterparties. Despite these costs, events persist. We find that assassinations increase with dependence on mining royalties, suggesting that local rents sustain conflict despite market pressure. Thus, reputational sanctions may be significant—even in weakly institutionalized settings—yet may not fully deter misbehavior when local and global incentives diverge.
abstract_zh: 市场能否对海外高成本不当行为形成约束？本文聚焦重大人权侵犯事件——具体而言，即采矿活动人士遇刺事件（此类情境下正式法律救济极为罕见，且事件通常不涉及交易对手方），探究市场惩罚机制。研究表明，媒体报道中涉及此类事件的企业会遭受显著且负面的异常股票收益。相较于企业不当行为相关反应可能具有短暂性或弱化特征，我们发现市场反应既显著又持久，其中位10日损失超过1亿美元。鉴于正式法律制裁极为罕见，我们重点考察市场惩罚的作用机制。我们提出与声誉成本相一致的三种传导路径：（1）媒体关注放大了市场反应；（2）信息敏感型机构投资者在刺杀事件后系统性减持；（3）事件导致未来贸易减少，新合同签订量下降19%。尽管存在这些成本，事件仍持续发生。研究发现，刺杀事件与矿业特许权使用费依赖度呈正相关，表明即便面临市场压力，地方租金仍会维持冲突。因此，声誉制裁在制度薄弱环境中可能具有显著效力，但当地方与全球激励存在分歧时，未必能完全遏制不当行为。

title: DP21707 Literature Review and Evidence Aggregation: a Toolkit for Applied Micro
title_zh: 文献综述与证据汇总：应用微观经济学工具包
title_primary: 文献综述与证据汇总：应用微观经济学工具包
title_secondary: DP21707 Literature Review and Evidence Aggregation: a Toolkit for Applied Micro
authors: Maximilian Kasy, Peter Ganong, Avik Garg
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Consider an analyst interested in predicting the size of an effect. She has identified a set of prior published studies of similar effects. We provide a toolkit for (i) summarizing the prior literature, (ii) making predictions of effects in new contexts, and (iii) correcting for the bias from selectivity in the prior literature. We illustrate these methods with empirical examples from labor, public, behavioral, environmental, and development economics. Some of the tools are relevant even when only three prior studies are available. We show how it is possible to use covariates to transparently make predictions for a new context by reweighting prior estimates. The mean effect---after correcting for selectivity---is between 12% and 21% of the simple mean in our empirical examples. We conclude with a cookbook for practitioners producing meta-analyses.
abstract_zh: 考虑一位分析师，其目标是预测某一效应的大小。她已确定一组关于类似效应的先前已发表研究。我们提供了一套工具包，用于：(i) 总结先前文献，(ii) 预测新情境下的效应，以及 (iii) 纠正先前文献中选择性偏差带来的偏误。我们通过来自劳动经济学、公共经济学、行为经济学、环境经济学和发展经济学的实证案例来展示这些方法。即便仅有三项先前研究可用，部分工具仍具适用性。我们展示了如何通过重新加权先前估计值，利用协变量透明地预测新情境下的效应。在我们的实证案例中，经选择性偏差校正后的平均效应，仅为简单均值的12%至21%。最后，我们为从事元分析的研究者提供了一份操作指南。

title: The effect of a woman-friendly occupation on employment: U.S. postmasters before World War II
title_zh: 女性友好职业对就业的影响：二战前美国邮政局长
title_primary: 女性友好职业对就业的影响：二战前美国邮政局长
title_secondary: The effect of a woman-friendly occupation on employment: U.S. postmasters before World War II
authors: Sophie Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I examine the effect of a woman-friendly occupation on employment by exploring a unique historical setting -- the postmaster occupation during the early twentieth-century United States. Unlike many occupations that established practices to prevent married women from entering, postmasters were open to married women and offered flexible work arrangements and equal pay. With a novel dataset on postmaster appointments and census linking, I show that postmasters attracted qualified women who were not gainfully employed previously. However, the postmaster occupation offered women few benefits beyond the appointed term. Taking advantage of the fact that postmasters were presidential appointees and were rarely re-appointed after the party of the president changed, I compare the 1940 outcomes of women appointed just before and after the 1933 presidential transition in a regression discontinuity (RD) design. The RD estimates suggest that women experienced a 26.7 percentage points reduction in gainful employment after finishing their postmaster term. The negative employment effect is unique to women and does not apply to men appointed under the same circumstances. In addition, I show that women postmasters were not more likely to be employed than their women neighbors who had never been postmasters, despite their work experience. The lack of benefits for women's future employment is in part explained by state-level discrimination against married women working and the severity of the Great Depression.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察20世纪初美国邮政局长这一独特的历史职业背景，探究了女性友好型职业对就业的影响。与许多通过制度性规定阻止已婚女性进入的职业不同，邮政局长职位对已婚女性开放，并提供灵活的工作安排与同工同酬。基于邮政局长任命记录与人口普查关联数据构建的新数据集，本研究发现：邮政局长职位吸引了此前未从事有酬工作的合格女性。然而，该职业除任期内的权益外，几乎未为女性提供长期职业发展优势。利用邮政局长由总统任命、且总统所属政党更迭后极少获得连任的制度特征，本文采用断点回归设计（RD），比较了1933年总统权力交接前后被任命的女性在1940年的就业状况。断点回归估计表明，女性在结束邮政局长任期后，有酬就业率下降26.7个百分点。这一负面就业效应仅存在于女性群体，在相同条件下任命的男性并未出现类似现象。此外，研究显示，尽管拥有工作经验，女性邮政局长与其从未担任该职位的女性邻居相比，就业概率并未更高。女性未来就业缺乏职业红利的部分原因，可归因于各州对已婚女性就业的歧视政策以及大萧条时期的严重经济冲击。

title: The Aggregate Costs of Uninsurable Business Risk
title_zh: 不可保险商业风险的总体成本
title_primary: 不可保险商业风险的总体成本
title_secondary: The Aggregate Costs of Uninsurable Business Risk
authors: Corina Boar, Denis Gorea, Virgiliu Midrigan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We use firm-level data to document that private businesses experience large fluctuations in their profit shares. These are due to large, fat-tailed, and transitory changes in output that are not fully accompanied by changes in their inputs. We interpret this evidence using a model of entrepreneurial dynamics. Because firms can limit their exposure to risk by operating at a smaller scale, our model predicts large macroeconomic losses from uninsurable business risk, much larger than those stemming from credit constraints. While self-financing allows entrepreneurs to quickly overcome credit constraints, even wealthy entrepreneurs remain considerably exposed to risk. (JEL D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26)
abstract_zh: 我们利用企业层面数据证明，私营企业的利润份额存在大幅波动。这种波动源于产出的大规模、厚尾且暂时性的变化，而这些变化并未完全伴随投入要素的同步调整。我们通过一个企业家动态模型来解释这一现象。由于企业可以通过缩小经营规模来限制风险敞口，我们的模型预测，不可保的商业风险将导致巨大的宏观经济损失，其规模远超信贷约束所造成的损失。尽管自我融资使企业家能够迅速克服信贷约束，但即使是富裕的企业家仍面临显著的风险敞口。（JEL分类号：D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26）

title: Insurer Risk and Public Risk-Sharing: Quantifying the Value of Reinsurance
title_zh: 保险公司风险与公共风险分担：再保险价值的量化
title_primary: 保险公司风险与公共风险分担：再保险价值的量化
title_secondary: Insurer Risk and Public Risk-Sharing: Quantifying the Value of Reinsurance
authors: Paul H S Kim, Anran Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the role of public risk-sharing in markets where firms face substantial cost uncertainty, focusing on public reinsurance in health insurance. We develop a model where insurers internalize cost uncertainty through risk charges that raise effective marginal costs, and create a role for reinsurance. Public reinsurance lowers both expected costs and cost volatility, particularly for smaller insurers, reducing prices and enhancing competition. Using an event study of staggered state-level reinsurance programs, we show that public reinsurance leads insurers to lower prices and private reinsurance purchases, benefiting financially constrained insurers the most. Structural estimates indicate that risk charges account for a substantial share of the premium-cost wedge, and highlight public reinsurance's comparative advantage over premium subsidies by providing risk protection and enhancing competition. Our results underscore the importance of accounting for firms’ risk exposure in policy design and provide a general framework for understanding public risk-sharing policies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究企业在面临巨大成本不确定性时公共风险分担的作用，重点关注健康保险中的公共再保险。我们构建了一个模型，其中保险公司通过风险费用将成本不确定性内部化，从而提高有效边际成本，并为再保险创造了空间。公共再保险降低了预期成本和成本波动性，尤其对小型保险公司而言，从而降低了价格并增强了竞争。利用各州分阶段实施再保险计划的事件研究法，我们发现公共再保险促使保险公司降低价格并减少私人再保险购买，对财务受限的保险公司影响最大。结构估计表明，风险费用在保费与成本差额中占很大比重，并凸显了公共再保险相较于保费补贴的比较优势，因为它能提供风险保护并增强竞争。我们的研究结果强调了在政策设计中考虑企业风险暴露的重要性，并为理解公共风险分担政策提供了一个通用框架。

abstract: The energy transition from coal to gas is reshaping the power sector to rely more on gas generation, which is cleaner but has more variable input costs. Using counterfactual analysis, I study the competitive effects of this transition, by considering several transition paths that differ in the types of firms involved in retiring coal plants and investing in gas plants. I show that the variable nature of the marginal cost of gas generation creates an environment in which market power could increase after the transition. However, the transition's impact on competition depends on the characteristics of the firms investing in new gas generation; the adverse impact is mitigated under a well‐planned transition that leads to a more competitive industry structure.
abstract_zh: 从煤炭向天然气的能源转型正重塑电力行业，使其更加依赖天然气发电——这种发电方式更清洁，但投入成本波动性更大。通过反事实分析，本文研究了这一转型的竞争效应，考虑了若干种不同的转型路径，这些路径在参与退役燃煤电厂和投资天然气电厂的企业类型上存在差异。研究表明，天然气发电边际成本的波动性特征创造了一种环境，使得转型后市场势力可能增强。然而，转型对竞争的影响取决于投资新建天然气发电企业的特征；在精心规划的转型路径下，这种不利影响会得到缓解，从而形成更具竞争性的行业结构。

title: Bounding the Effect of Persuasion with Monotonicity Assumptions: Reassessing the Impact of TV Debates
title_zh: 单调性假设下说服效应的边界：重新评估电视辩论的影响
title_primary: 单调性假设下说服效应的边界：重新评估电视辩论的影响
title_secondary: Bounding the Effect of Persuasion with Monotonicity Assumptions: Reassessing the Impact of TV Debates
authors: Sung Jae Jun, Sokbae Lee
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Televised debates between presidential candidates are often regarded as the exemplar of persuasive communication. Yet, recent evidence from Le Pennec and Pons (2023) indicates that they may not sway voters as strongly as popular belief suggests. We revisit their findings through the lens of the persuasion rate and introduce a robust framework that does not require exogenous treatment, parallel trends, or credible instruments. Instead, we leverage plausible monotonicity assumptions to partially identify the persuasion rate and related parameters. Our results reaffirm that the sharp upper bounds on the persuasive effects of TV debates remain modest.
abstract_zh: 摘要 总统候选人之间的电视辩论常被视为说服性传播的典范。然而，Le Pennec与Pons（2023）的最新证据表明，其影响选民的程度可能远不及普遍认知。我们通过说服率视角重新审视其研究发现，并引入一个无需外生处理、平行趋势或可信工具变量的稳健框架。相反，我们利用合理的单调性假设对说服率及相关参数进行部分识别。研究结果再次证实，电视辩论说服效应的严格上界仍较为有限。

title: Long‐Term Debt and Short‐Term Rates: Fixed‐Rate Mortgages and Monetary Transmission
title_zh: 长期债务与短期利率：固定利率抵押贷款与货币政策传导
title_primary: 长期债务与短期利率：固定利率抵押贷款与货币政策传导
title_secondary: Long‐Term Debt and Short‐Term Rates: Fixed‐Rate Mortgages and Monetary Transmission
authors: ALESSIA DE STEFANI, RUI C. MANO
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the two‐way relationship between fixed‐rate mortgages (FRMs) and monetary policy in a panel of up to 35 countries observed over the last two decades. The data set includes quarterly information on the composition of mortgage flows and stocks by type of rate‐fixation and monetary policy shocks cleaned of information effects. Using instrumental‐variable local projections, we show that FRMs induce both path‐ and state‐dependency in monetary transmission. Changes in policy rates shape mortgage choice, increasing (decreasing) the share of FRMs during easing (tightening) cycles. Over time, this mechanism alters the composition of the outstanding mortgage stock which, in turn, affects the central bank's ability to stabilize the economy ex‐post . A greater (lower) prevalence of FRMs weakens (strengthens) monetary policy transmission to real private consumption and GDP.
abstract_zh: 本文基于过去二十年间最多35个国家的面板数据，研究了固定利率抵押贷款（FRMs）与货币政策之间的双向关系。数据集包含按利率固定类型划分的抵押贷款流量与存量的季度信息，以及剔除信息效应后的货币政策冲击。通过工具变量局部投影法，我们证明FRMs在货币政策传导中同时引发路径依赖与状态依赖。政策利率的变化会塑造抵押贷款选择：在宽松（紧缩）周期中，FRMs占比上升（下降）。随着时间推移，这一机制改变了未偿还抵押贷款存量的构成，进而影响央行事后稳定经济的能力。FRMs的较高（较低）普及率会削弱（增强）货币政策向实际私人消费与GDP的传导效果。

title: Private Interest in the Public Good: Cholera and the Origins of Sanitary Reform
title_zh: 公共利益中的私人利益：霍乱与卫生改革的起源
title_primary: 公共利益中的私人利益：霍乱与卫生改革的起源
title_secondary: Private Interest in the Public Good: Cholera and the Origins of Sanitary Reform
authors: Daniel Gallardo-Albarrán, Kalle Kappner
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: European countries paved the way for modern economic growth in the 19th century with large-scale reforms facilitating human capital accumulation. The literature has looked at the role of elites in broad education investments, but less attention has been devoted to reforms promoting workers' health, a key component of human capital. This paper studies the impact of the 1866 cholera outbreak on modern waterworks construction in the German Empire to test the hypothesis whether concerns about workers' health may have compelled elites to invest in health-enhancing public goods. We find that the epidemic raised the annual probability of building waterworks by about 35%. Exogenous variation relying on the cholera-spreading effect of military movements during the Austro-Prussian War in 1866 further underpins this result. Quantitative and qualitative evidence indicates that non-agricultural elites employing more productive capital and better-skilled workers pushed for reform to avoid the costly prospect of future labour shocks. Long-term analyses show sizeable and persisting effects of the epidemic on public health and development outcomes shortly before the First World War.
abstract_zh: 欧洲国家在19世纪通过大规模改革促进人力资本积累，为现代经济增长奠定了基础。现有文献关注了精英阶层在广泛教育投资中的作用，但较少关注促进工人健康（人力资本的关键组成部分）的改革。本文以1866年霍乱疫情对德意志帝国现代供水系统建设的影响为研究对象，检验以下假设：对工人健康的担忧是否可能促使精英阶层投资于增进健康的公共品。研究发现，疫情使供水系统建设的年概率提高了约35%。利用1866年普奥战争期间军事调动对霍乱传播的外生性影响，进一步验证了这一结果。定量与定性证据表明，雇佣更多生产性资本和技能更熟练工人的非农业精英阶层推动改革，以避免未来劳动力冲击带来的高昂成本。长期分析显示，疫情对第一次世界大战前夕的公共卫生与发展成果产生了显著且持续的影响。

title: Population decline, capital deepening, and productivity: cross-country evidence
title_zh: 人口下降、资本深化与生产率：跨国证据
title_primary: 人口下降、资本深化与生产率：跨国证据
title_secondary: Population decline, capital deepening, and productivity: cross-country evidence
authors: João Tovar Jalles
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between population decline, capital deepening, and productivity growth using cross-country panel data over 1975–2023. Consistent with standard growth theory, slower population growth is associated with faster capital deepening. Conditional on controls, it is also linked to stronger GDP per worker growth, particularly in more technologically advanced economies. The results suggest that demographic headwinds can induce adjustment through capital deepening and labor-saving technologies. While population decline is not inherently beneficial, endogenous investment and technology responses partly offset its adverse effects on growth.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1975年至2023年的跨国面板数据，考察了人口下降、资本深化与生产率增长之间的关系。与标准增长理论一致，人口增长放缓与资本深化加速相关联。在控制相关变量后，这种放缓还与人均GDP增长增强相关，尤其是在技术更为先进的经济体中。研究结果表明，人口逆风可通过资本深化和节约劳动型技术引发调整。尽管人口下降本身并非有益，但内生投资和技术响应部分抵消了其对增长的不利影响。

title: An almost laboratory experiment: John Cowperthwaite and Hong Kong’s economic prosperity
title_zh: 近乎实验室实验：约翰·考珀斯韦特与香港经济繁荣
title_primary: 近乎实验室实验：约翰·考珀斯韦特与香港经济繁荣
title_secondary: An almost laboratory experiment: John Cowperthwaite and Hong Kong’s economic prosperity
authors: Vincent Geloso, Jamie Bologna Pavlik, Yang Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Milton Friedman, in the 1960s, was convinced that John Cowperthwaite, the British official overseeing Hong Kong’s economic policy, was conducting the most radical experiment in economic history. A staunch classical liberal within the British civil service, Cowperthwaite aggressively resisted government intervention, believing that free markets fueled growth. His influence was amplified by British domestic politics and the nature of colonial rule, making him a uniquely powerful figure. In this paper, we use the Synthetic Control Method (SCM) and Synthetic Difference-in-Differences (SDID) to assess whether Cowperthwaite truly constrained government expansion and whether his policies drove economic growth. In other words, we test whether Friedman overstated Cowperthwaite’s impact. We find strong evidence that Cowperthwaite limited government growth but had no visible effect on economic growth. We link these results to Hong Kong’s land policies, their impact on government size metrics, and more even-handed assessments of Cowperthwaite’s policy decisions.
abstract_zh: 20世纪60年代，米尔顿·弗里德曼确信，负责香港经济政策的英国官员约翰·考珀斯韦特正在实施经济史上最激进的实验。作为英国文官体系中坚定的古典自由主义者，考珀斯韦特强烈抵制政府干预，坚信自由市场能推动增长。英国国内政治与殖民统治的特性放大了他的影响力，使其成为一位拥有独特权力的关键人物。本文采用合成控制法（SCM）与合成双重差分法（SDID），评估考珀斯韦特是否真正限制了政府扩张，以及他的政策是否推动了经济增长。换言之，我们检验弗里德曼是否夸大了考珀斯韦特的影响。研究发现，考珀斯韦特确实限制了政府规模增长，但对经济增长并无显著影响。我们将这些结果与香港的土地政策、其对政府规模指标的影响，以及对考珀斯韦特政策决策更为公允的评价联系起来。

title: Dynamic Factor Correlations
title_zh: 动态因子相关性
title_primary: 动态因子相关性
title_secondary: Dynamic Factor Correlations
authors: Chen Tong, Peter Reinhard Hansen
official: 官方在线 2026-05-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We introduce a dynamic factor correlation model whose core methodological innovation is a variation‐free parametrization of dynamic factor loadings, inspired by the generalized Fisher transformation. The model accommodates time‐varying correlations, heterogeneous heavy tails, and dependent idiosyncratic shocks. Applied to a Small Universe of 12 assets and a Large Universe of 323 stocks, the factor structure induces a sparse idiosyncratic correlation matrix with dependencies concentrated within subindustries, enabling scalability to high dimensions under a sparse block structure. Both factor loadings and correlations vary substantially. Allowing for heterogeneous heavy tails via convolution‐ distributions yields sizable improvements relative to Gaussian and multivariate‐ benchmarks.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种动态因子相关模型，其核心方法论创新在于受广义费舍尔变换启发的动态因子载荷的无变化参数化方法。该模型能够适应时变相关性、异质性厚尾以及相依的特异性冲击。将该模型应用于包含12项资产的小型资产池和包含323只股票的大型资产池时，因子结构产生了一个稀疏的特异性相关矩阵，其中依赖性集中在子行业内，从而在稀疏块结构下实现了对高维度的可扩展性。因子载荷与相关性均表现出显著变化。通过卷积分布允许异质性厚尾的存在，相较于高斯基准和多元基准，带来了显著的改进。

title: Credit card interchange fees revisited: The role of credit and consumer behavior
title_zh: 信用卡交换费再审视：信贷与消费者行为的作用
title_primary: 信用卡交换费再审视：信贷与消费者行为的作用
title_secondary: Credit card interchange fees revisited: The role of credit and consumer behavior
authors: José Ignacio Heresi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I revisit the issue of optimal regulation of credit card interchange fees by considering the incentives arising in the credit market. I model credit cards as offering a base payment instrument and an add-on credit product. By connecting the interchange fee and add-on pricing literature, I show that issuers’ per-transaction fees are lower than when no credit is offered, as issuers aim to induce more demand for the credit feature of the cards. Moreover, total welfare now considers the social costs and benefits of different forms of credit. I discuss how these effects influence optimal interchange fee regulation and examine spillovers between credit market regulations and welfare-maximizing interchange fees.
abstract_zh: 我重新审视信用卡交换费的最优监管问题，通过考虑信贷市场中产生的激励因素。我将信用卡建模为提供基础支付工具和附加信贷产品。通过将交换费与附加定价文献相结合，我证明发卡机构的每笔交易费用低于不提供信贷时的水平，因为发卡机构旨在诱导对信用卡信贷功能的更多需求。此外，总福利现在考虑了不同形式信贷的社会成本与收益。我讨论了这些效应如何影响最优交换费监管，并考察了信贷市场监管与福利最大化交换费之间的溢出效应。

title: How religion mediates the fertility response to maternity benefits
title_zh: 宗教如何调节生育福利对生育率的影响
title_primary: 宗教如何调节生育福利对生育率的影响
title_secondary: How religion mediates the fertility response to maternity benefits
authors: Elizabeth Brainerd, Olga Malkova
official: 官方在线 2026-04-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Do religious beliefs affect responses to fertility incentives? We examine a 1982 maternity benefits expansion in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania in a difference-in-differences framework with similar East European countries as comparisons. To isolate the importance of religion, we compare women who did and did not grow up in religious households when religion was formally outlawed, resulting in similar adult characteristics among women in the Baltics by importance of religion. Maternity benefits increased fertility only among women who grew up in religious families, providing novel evidence that cultural norms transmitted through the family can amplify the effects of public policies.
abstract_zh: 宗教信仰是否会影响人们对生育激励的反应？我们利用1982年爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和立陶宛的产假福利扩展，在双重差分框架下，以相似的东欧国家作为对照组进行比较。为隔离宗教的重要性，我们比较了在宗教被正式禁止时期成长于宗教家庭与非宗教家庭的女性，结果显示波罗的海国家女性在成年特征上因宗教重要性而相似。产假福利仅提高了在宗教家庭中成长的女性的生育率，这提供了新的证据表明，通过家庭传递的文化规范可以放大公共政策的效果。

title: Trade fragmentation, inflationary pressures and monetary policy
title_zh: 贸易碎片化、通胀压力与货币政策
title_primary: 贸易碎片化、通胀压力与货币政策
title_secondary: Trade fragmentation, inflationary pressures and monetary policy
authors: Ludovica Ambrosino, Jenny Chan, Silvana Tenreyro
official: 官方在线 2026-01-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How does trade fragmentation affect inflationary pressures? What is the response of monetary policy needed to sustain inflation at target? To address these questions, we develop a two-sector, small open-economy model that features imperfect international risk-sharing and household heterogeneity, capturing both the supply-side and demand-side effects of fragmentation. In the model, fragmentation takes the form of import-price increases or a decline in tradable-sector productivity. The sign and magnitude of its impact on inflationary pressures, and the appropriate policy response, depend not only on the direct effect of higher import prices or lower productivity on supply but also, crucially, on how aggregate demand adjusts to lower real incomes. In turn, this depends on the pace of fragmentation (gradual versus front-loaded) and other key structural factors highlighted by the model. We compare outcomes under Taylor-type monetary policy rules to a constrained-efficient allocation.
abstract_zh: 贸易碎片化如何影响通胀压力？为维持通胀目标，货币政策需要作出何种反应？为解答这些问题，我们构建了一个包含不完全国际风险分担和家庭异质性的两部门小型开放经济体模型，以捕捉碎片化对供给侧和需求侧的双重影响。在该模型中，碎片化表现为进口价格上升或可贸易部门生产率下降。其对通胀压力的影响方向与程度，以及相应的政策应对，不仅取决于进口价格上升或生产率下降对供给的直接效应，还关键地取决于总需求如何适应实际收入下降。而这一适应过程又取决于碎片化的速度（渐进式与前置式）以及模型所强调的其他关键结构性因素。我们将泰勒型货币政策规则下的结果与约束有效配置进行了比较。

title: Evaluating passive fund performance: short-term versus long-term metrics
title_zh: 被动基金绩效评估：短期与长期指标的比较
title_primary: 被动基金绩效评估：短期与长期指标的比较
title_secondary: Evaluating passive fund performance: short-term versus long-term metrics
authors: Ailie Charteris, Kerry McCullough, Lorraine Muguto
official: 官方在线 2025-09-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Traditional passive fund performance evaluation relies on tracking error metrics, which have a short-term orientation. As such, these metrics may not appropriately quantify the long-term performance of passive funds, which is of particular interest to buy-and-hold investors. This study considers the potential shortcomings of current passive investment evaluation practices by comparing the performance of a sample of United States equity exchange traded funds (ETFs) based on short-run (tracking error) and long-run (cointegration-based) tracking metrics over the period 1 January 2013 to 25 September 2024. The cointegration approach employed accommodates structural breaks. Our findings reveal significant disparities in rankings, highlighting the importance of aligning performance evaluation with investment horizons. We also introduce a novel metric, ‘Overall Tracking Performance’, which integrates both short- and long-run measures. Finally, we demonstrate that top-performing funds maintain consistent tracking performance over successive periods, irrespective of the measure of tracking performance. These results offer meaningful insights for both investors and fund managers seeking a more comprehensive approach to passive fund performance evaluation.
abstract_zh: 传统被动型基金绩效评估依赖跟踪误差指标，这类指标具有短期导向性。对于长期持有型投资者尤为关注的被动型基金长期绩效，这些指标可能无法进行恰当量化。本研究通过对比2013年1月1日至2024年9月25日期间美国股票交易所交易基金（ETF）样本基于短期（跟踪误差）与长期（协整）跟踪指标的绩效表现，探讨当前被动投资评估实践存在的潜在缺陷。所采用的协整方法能够适应结构性突变。研究结果揭示排名存在显著差异，凸显了绩效评估与投资期限相匹配的重要性。我们同时引入"综合跟踪绩效"这一新型指标，该指标整合了短期与长期度量维度。最后证明，无论采用何种跟踪绩效度量方式，表现最优的基金均能在连续期间保持稳定的跟踪绩效。这些发现为寻求更全面被动型基金绩效评估方法的投资者与基金管理人提供了重要启示。

title: Wealth and the origins of the education take-off
title_zh: 财富与教育起飞的起源
title_primary: 财富与教育起飞的起源
title_secondary: Wealth and the origins of the education take-off
authors: Michele Battisti, Antonio Francesco Gravina, Andrea Mario Lavezzi, Giuseppe Maggio, Giorgio Tortorici
official: 官方在线 2025-06-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: What role does wealth play in shaping educational choices? While theoretical frameworks generate elaborate, testable predictions, there are significant hurdles in empirically assessing this relationship. In modern societies, compulsory education laws conceal the impact of wealth on educational decisions. To address this challenge, we draw on a unique dataset from 1858 that records municipal-level wealth shares alongside primary school enrollment across Sicily, an ideal historical setting in which schools were present in nearly every municipality, yet attendance was voluntary. Leveraging the long-term effects of historical earthquakes on land and property distribution-effects that reshaped the wealth structure of Sicilian municipalities in the mid-19th century, we examine the impact of wealth on schooling decisions. Our analysis shows that wealth played a significant role in educational outcomes even in a largely agrarian context: a 10% increase in the share of wealthy households was associated with a 0.6% increase in primary school enrollment.
abstract_zh: 财富在塑造教育选择中扮演何种角色？尽管理论框架能够产生详尽且可检验的预测，但在实证评估这一关系时仍面临重大障碍。在现代社会中，义务教育法掩盖了财富对教育决策的影响。为应对这一挑战，我们利用1858年一项独特的数据集，该数据集记录了西西里各市镇的财富份额与小学入学率。这一历史背景具有理想的研究条件：几乎每个市镇都设有学校，但入学完全自愿。借助历史地震对土地与财产分配的长期影响——这些影响在19世纪中期重塑了西西里各市镇的财富结构，我们考察了财富对教育决策的作用。分析表明，即便在高度农业化的背景下，财富对教育成果仍具有显著影响：富裕家庭比例每增加10%，小学入学率相应提高0.6%。

title: Is Recycling Effective? Evidence from California between 2004 and 2017
title_zh: 回收是否有效？来自加利福尼亚州2004年至2017年的证据
title_primary: 回收是否有效？来自加利福尼亚州2004年至2017年的证据
title_secondary: Is Recycling Effective? Evidence from California between 2004 and 2017
authors: Makridis, C. A.
official: 官方在线 2021-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using county data from California between 2004 and 2017, this article exploits changes in households’ exposure to hazardous waste recycling to identify the effects on potential environmental and economic outcomes. While a 10% rise in recycling per household is associated with a 0.28% and 0.94% improvement in air quality and a decline in the number of unhealthy days in a year, recycling is associated with a rise in net energy generation and fuel consumption and not associated with economic activity. There is some evidence that households in zip codes with higher housing values and population density value reductions in hazardous waste. JEL Q53Q58
abstract_zh: 本文利用2004年至2017年间加利福尼亚州的县级数据，通过家庭暴露于危险废物回收的变化来识别其对潜在环境和经济结果的影响。尽管每户回收量增加10%与空气质量改善0.28%和0.94%以及一年中不健康天数减少相关，但回收与净能源发电量和燃料消耗的增加相关，且与经济活动无关联。有证据表明，住房价值较高和人口密度较大的邮政编码区域内的家庭更看重危险废物的减少。JEL分类号：Q53，Q58
